definitions.gloss: repair cost; maintenance expense; repair fee
definitions.explanation: The cost incurred for repairing or maintaining buildings, equipment, or other property. A standard term in real estate, accounting, and property management.

examples.japanese: {修繕費|しゅうぜんひ}は{誰|だれ}が{負担|ふたん}するのか。
マンションの{修繕費|しゅうぜんひ}が{値上|ねあ}がりした。
examples.english: The condominium repair fees went up.

examples.japanese: {老朽化|ろうきゅうか}した{建物|たてもの}は{修繕費|しゅうぜんひ}がかさむ。
examples.english: Repair costs add up for aging buildings.

notes:
Composed of {修繕|しゅうぜん} (repair, mending) + {費|ひ} (cost, expense). Very commonly encountered in real estate and condominium management. In Japanese condominiums ({分譲|ぶんじょう}マンション), residents pay a monthly {修繕積立金|しゅうぜんつみたてきん} (repair reserve fund) for future building maintenance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {修繕費|しゅうぜんひ}を{負担|ふたん}する: to bear repair costs
- {修繕費|しゅうぜんひ}がかかる: to incur repair costs
- {修繕積立金|しゅうぜんつみたてきん}: repair reserve fund
- {大規模|だいきぼ}{修繕|しゅうぜん}: large-scale repair/renovation

RELATED WORDS:
- {管理費|かんりひ}: management fee
- {維持費|いじひ}: maintenance cost
- {修理代|しゅうりだい}: repair charge (more informal)
